    # The frequent color is the field; zero cells are candidate locations.
    from collections import Counter
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for v in counts if v not in (0, background)]
    if not colors:
        return g
    color = min(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    shape = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in shape)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in shape)
    offsets = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in shape]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
